title: Mike Lee piñata, Trump head painting draw ire at Utah Pride event
text:

Outrage has grown online after images and video from a Pride event in Provo showed a piñata resembling U.S. Sen. Mike Lee being batted by children, a painting of President Donald Trump's severed head on a platter, and decorative Molotov cocktails for sale.
at 5:55PM at Memorial Park in Provo!” The Cougar Pride Center told KUTV that vendors are “minimally vetted.” In guidelines sent to participants, the group discouraged lewd or violent displays and urged vendors to keep the event family-friendly. “Please, when preparing to table at the event, make this an event you can invite your grandma or your LDS family to,” the guidelines read. “Let’s make this pride uplifting, wholesome, colorful, community-centered.” In its 2026 Pride in Progress statement of purpose, the center defended the need for such gatherings amid what it called rising hate and injustice. “Community, being together, making ourselves seen, is what those who would destroy us fear most,” the group wrote. “There are scary things going on in the world, and it’s understandable to be afraid. Every day, it seems that there are more and more voices on the side of hate and injustice, but we cannot allow fear to keep us locked up in our homes, attempting to hide from the things that scare us.” Brigham Young University distanced itself from the event, stating online in response to posts about the event: “This is not a BYU group, not a BYU-sponsored event, and did not happen on BYU campus.” The controversy has drawn sharp criticism from conservatives who say the imagery promotes or normalizes political violence, especially at a public, all-ages event.Leading Democratic candidate for Congress Nate Blouin may have more explaining to do.Punchbowl News, a Washington, DC based political publication, reports it haA man faces a federal drug charge after more than 176 pounds of methamphetamine was seized during a traffic stop last month.a federal grand jury in St. GeorgeA 20-year-old man reported missing out of Green River was found dead on the west side of town.Alex James Booth, 20, of Jamestown, was reported missing at approxA family was left shaken up after they said a group of people tried to kick in their door.Last Friday night, the group reportedly tried to break in but ran afteUtah Rep.
